gate_results.name: rule_compliance

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Of 2,101 eligible training and 730 validation fast-policy states, zero had a registered 12-decision future hazard label. The minimum 40 and 10 positive labels was not met; no classifier checkpoint was trained.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: This was a TRAIN-only feasibility run with two unchanged actors, not a learned candidate comparison. Fast-only finished 12/12 versus mode switch 9/12 on this one new TRAIN block; it is a local observation and not fresh candidate promotion evidence.
